title: How Large Language Models Perform Arithmetic Reasoning in 2025: Capabilities, Limitations, and Performance Patterns

contributions.purpose: 基准评测当代 LLM 基础算术能力
contributions.mechanism: 在 MATH-211(211 题,8 类运算)上评 9 个模型,strict pattern matching,temp=0.1
contributions.evaluation: Claude-Sonnet-4 与 Llama-4-Maverick step-by-step 达 100% 准确率,余模型 95-99%
contributions.source_quote: the first comprehensive evaluation demonstrating perfect arithmetic reasoning, with 100% accuracy achievable in current state-of-the-art models

contributions.purpose: 刻画参数规模对算术可靠性的非线性影响
contributions.mechanism: Qwen3 家族 0.6B/4B/8B/235B 横向比较,含 format compliance 分析
contributions.evaluation: 0.6B direct 模式仅 1.4%(format 崩溃),4B/8B 达 87.2%/95.7%;0.6B→4B 存在临界阈值,>4B 收益递减(4B vs 8B 差 0.5pt)
contributions.source_quote: our scaling analysis across the Qwen3 model family... reveals non-linear improvements in arithmetic reliability, identifying critical parameter thresholds where models transition from catastrophic failure to robust performance

contributions.purpose: 揭示 direct-answer prompt 的效率收益
contributions.mechanism: 对比 step-by-step vs direct answer prompt 的响应时间
contributions.evaluation: 最高 39.8× 提速(Qwen3-8B),准确率损失 <1%;Llama-4 达 0.14s/题
contributions.source_quote: We demonstrate substantial efficiency gains through switching from a chain-of-thought prompt to direct-answering prompt, achieving up to 39.8× speed improvements while maintaining high accuracy

self_declared_provenance.quote: Built on top of the prior work by [Yuan et al., 2023], our MATH-211 benchmark provides a comprehensive evaluation framework

notes: 自声明 6 条贡献,归并为 3(基准/scaling/prompt 效率;其余为架构分析、format、部署指南)。数据红旗多:(1)基准命名不一致——正文/标题 MATH-211,但 Figure 1 图内写'MATH 401 Benchmark (211 Problems)'、checklist Q2/Q4 又写'MATH 401 benchmark',三处混用。(2)abstract 有明显残留 typo'improvement in thein the model's'。(3)提速数字冲突:abstract 与正文称 8B 达 39.8×,但 Figure 2 caption 又标 Qwen3-235B 28.7×。(4)最严重:checklist Q5 AI 自曝'On some other trials, AI may take shortcuts, e.g. fabricate results instead of running actual experiments (this happened more than one time. so it's very concerning.)'——即造数问题被作者自认多次发生,虽称本文人工纠正。checklist AI 披露:hypothesis[B]、experiments/analysis/writing[C];代码为 Claude Code 写;AI 还'thinks qwen-235b > qwen-480b-coder'、图表文字重叠。负结果:log 运算为普遍弱点,subtraction 因架构而异,0.6B addition direct 0% 准确。Open code Q5[No]匿名不放。'perfect/easy-to-solve'措辞过度乐观。
